Class RBridge

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.rbridge.RBridge
public final class RBridge extends Object
The connection of Bio7 to R: embedded R in the process of Bio7. The values are RValue of the plugin com.eco.bio7.rffm, e.g., RBridge.getBackend().eval("mean(x)").firstDouble().
